facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.create_dataset: create a Dataset instance that loads train, valid, and test splits from pickle or numpy files

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.invert_triples_numpy: invert numpy triples to add reciprocal relations by swapping head and tail entities

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.evaluate_model: evaluate a KBCModel on a dataset split computing MRR and hits at k metrics

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.setup_model: build a knowledge graph embedding model like TransE, ComplEx, TuckER, RESCAL, or CP from an options dict
facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.setup_loss: create a loss function like BCEWithLogitsLoss or CrossEntropyLoss based on the world setting in options
facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.setup_regularizer: build a regularizer like F2 or N3 with a given lambda value from an options dict

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.build_TransE_model: build a TransE knowledge base completion model with entity and relation embeddings for link prediction
facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.build_ComplEx_model: build a ComplEx model using complex-valued embeddings for scoring knowledge graph triples
facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.build_TuckER_model: build a TuckER tensor factorization model with a core tensor for knowledge base completion
facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.build_RESCAL_model: build a RESCAL model with relation-specific transformation matrices for scoring knowledge graph triples
facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.build_CP_model: build a CP tensor decomposition model with separate embeddings for head entities, relations, and tail entities

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.prepare_dataset_ogb_wikikg2: prepare the ogbl-wikikg2 dataset by downloading, splitting triples, and saving train/valid/test arrays as numpy files

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.index_triples_across_type: index triples across different entity types by assigning type indices and offsetting entity IDs per type
facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.run_preprocess_datasets: run the main script to preprocess one or more datasets including ogbl-wikikg2, ogbl-biokg, or custom graph datasets

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.create_N3_regularizer: create an N3 regularizer instance with a lambda coefficient for L3 penalty computation

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.compute_N3_penalty: compute the normalized L3 penalty and raw sum of cubed absolute factors using N3

facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.get_grad_norm_model: compute the L2 norm of all gradients across a PyTorch model parameters including sparse gradients
facebookresearch_ssl-relation-prediction.to_networkx_triples: build a NetworkX directed graph from knowledge graph triples with optional predicate filtering
